title: 宽带坏了，打客服电话怎么说？
summary: 家里断网：打电话给宽带公司，描述问题、重启路由器、约上门维修。

phrases.en: Can you help me reset my router?
phrases.zh: 能帮我重置一下路由器吗？

phrases.en: Have you tried restarting your router?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Hi, my WiFi isn't working since this morning.
dialogue.zh: 你好，我家无线网从今天早上就连不上了。

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: I'm sorry. Have you tried restarting your router?
dialogue.zh: 很抱歉，试过重启路由器吗？

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Yes, twice. It's still not working.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.en: Let me reset it from my side. Please wait two minutes.
dialogue.zh: 我从这边帮你重置一下，等两分钟。

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.en: Okay... it's working now. Thank you!

seoTitle: 美国宽带坏了英语怎么说？打客服电话对话
seoDescription: 家里断网打宽带客服：描述问题、重启路由器的完整英语说法，附真实对话。
